generationInputs.prompt: A high-quality studio shot of a gold-toned keychain against a clean white background, with a pretty and bright color palette. Dangling loosely from the keychain are several cute, distinct charms. Two charms depict animated male characters in a chibi art style. The first charm is a plushie of a fair-skinned male with spiky black hair, wearing an orange and blue martial arts gi, blue wristbands, and an orange belt. His eyes are wide, looking upwards, and he holds a dark, multi-pronged object. The second charm is a plushie of a fair-skinned male with spiky black hair, wearing a blue jumpsuit with white boots and gloves. His eyes are narrow and determined, and he holds silver scissors with open blades. Both charms have a smooth, opaque appearance. Additional charms, with a textured, reflective quality due to glitter, represent elements from a fantastical landscape: a rolling pink hill with delicate petals, and a cluster of seven round orange balloons each with four red, five-pointed stars. The lighting is even and bright, minimizing shadows and highlighting texture and details with sharp focus.
